    rs=[r for r,c,v in obj]; cs=[c for r,c,v in obj]
    r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs); h=max(rs)-r0+1; w=max(cs)-c0+1
    pat=[[obj[i+r0][j+c0] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    cr,cc=(h-1)//2,(w-1)//2   # pattern center
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for mr,mc_,mv in marks:

        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                rr,cc2=tr+i,tc+j
                if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc2<W:
                    out[rr][cc2]=pat[i][j]
    return out
